atoms.text: I can swim very well. In the summer, I go to the swimming pool with my best friend. And I can ride a bike. I have got a blue bike. I go to school by bike every day. I also have got a piano at home. I practice it on the weekend. But I can’t play the guitar.

atoms.text: I love football. I play football every weekend with my friends in the park. Sometimes we play after school too. I have got a football. I also like to watch TV. In the evening, I often watch my favourite cartoon. I don’t like to draw. But my brother loves it.

atoms.text: I have got a small family. I live with my parents and my sister. My sister is younger than I am. She is very funny. But sometimes she is annoying. My grandparents live in another city. We visit them often on weekends.
